Section 1. [+GITCHI GAMI STATE TRAIL. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

This appropriation is to construct a multiuse paved trail between Arrowhead Electric and Steam Engine Road in the city of Lutsen; to construct a multiuse paved trail between Superior Shores Road and Flood Bay State Wayside, including a bridge over coastal wetland and improvements to the trailhead and wayside at Flood Bay State Wayside; and to predesign and design a trail segment between Flood Bay State Wayside to Stewart River. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $4,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for the Gitchi Gami State Trail; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. GITCHI GAMI STATE TRAIL.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$4,500,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of natural resources for the development of three segments of the Gitchi Gami State Trail. This appropriation is to construct a multiuse paved trail between Arrowhead Electric and Steam Engine Road in the city of Lutsen; to construct a multiuse paved trail between Superior Shores Road and Flood Bay State Wayside, including a bridge over coastal wetland and improvements to the trailhead and wayside at Flood Bay State Wayside; and to predesign and design a trail segment between Flood Bay State Wayside to Stewart River.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $4,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $4,500,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of natural resources for the development of three segments of the Gitchi Gami State Trail. This appropriation is to construct a multiuse paved trail between Arrowhead Electric and Steam Engine Road in the city of Lutsen; to construct a multiuse paved trail between Superior Shores Road and Flood Bay State Wayside, including a bridge over coastal wetland and improvements to the trailhead and wayside at Flood Bay State Wayside; and to predesign and design a trail segment between Flood Bay State Wayside to Stewart River.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $4,500,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
